messages:
rachel: Quick pitch: 'OSS Speedrun'  two ultra-short tutorials (510m), one compact refapp repo, and a 25minute live bench + Q&A. Goal: low-friction starter flows -> dev signups + repo stars.

vik: I like the micro format. I'll draft a punchy launch post and three social hooks (one with a single hero stat). Keep CTAs to "Run in <10m".

leo: DevRel will produce the repo: single Python file, tiny deps, and a one-line Dockerfile. Also add a smoke bench that emits p50/p95 CSVs. ETA: 4 days for skeleton.

rachel: Routing: capture "company size" + "use case" on the form. Enterprise -> SDR; otherwise -> nurture + trial. Also add hidden utm param so we can attribute stars.

vik: Proposed UTM: utm_source=oss_speedrun&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=speedrun_launch&utm_content={variant}. Use same across blog/email/twitter.

leo: README run snippet I'll add: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/oss-speedrun.git && cd oss-speedrun && docker build -t oss-speedrun . && docker run --rm oss-speedrun ./bench.py --iters 30`

rachel: Webinar plan: 7m demo, 10m bench walkthrough, 8m Q&A. Cap 150, record for on-demand.

growth-bot: Template note -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/mini-checklist

vik: Action items: blog + social drafts by Tue; landing mock by Wed; repo PR by Fri. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

leo: :white_check_mark: starting repo.

vik: :white_check_mark: will post drafts in #marketing-drafts.

rachel: Thanks team  I'll create the Asana epic and loop in growth for paid support on launch week.
